title: Named color palette / Scrolling swatches

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Give a broad palette memorable names so designers can discuss variations without losing a common reference.
strategic_value: Playful names such as Dragon and Wipe Out can connect Twitch’s color vocabulary with its wider cultural voice.
demonstration: A vertical sequence scrolls rounded swatches labeled with names including Bandit, Cuddle, Dragon, Droid, Egg, Felicia, Ice, Jiggle, K.O., Legend, Lightning, Sniper, Sonic, Widow, Wipe Out and Zero.
practical_value: Compare the range of hues and label contrast; obtain production values from an authoritative specification before reuse.

content_islands.name: Swatch stack
content_islands.spec: Scroll one vertical column of rounded color cards through the portrait frame.

content_islands.name: Names
content_islands.spec: Keep each name near the upper-left corner, using light or dark lettering according to the shown card.

reference_purposes.Intent: COLLINS states that additional vibrant hues build on recognition of Twitch purple while representing a wider range of creators and audiences.
reference_purposes.Expression: Bright, pale and dark swatches use playful names rather than anonymous sample labels.

ingredient.name: Expanded named palette
ingredient.role: Provide variety around an established purple identity.
ingredient.application: Compare swatches as alternatives; the film does not specify usage percentages or production color values.
ingredient.scope: Observed in the historical COLLINS identity case study; no mandatory dimensions, color proportions or universal placement rule is supplied.
